quitConfirmation.title: Quit Stave
quitConfirmation.message: Are you sure you want to quit?
quitConfirmation.detail: Any running tasks will be stopped and unsaved changes may be lost.

unsavedChanges.title: Changes have not been saved
unsavedChanges.message: Stave could not save your latest workspace changes.
unsavedChanges.detail: Keep Stave open to preserve your current work, or retry saving before quitting.

rendererRecovery.unresponsive: The Stave conversation window is not responding.
rendererRecovery.detail: Reload to restore saved work. Recent changes that were not saved may be lost. Running tasks may continue in the background; check their activity after reloading before starting another run. Reloading does not resend your request.
